items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: this is Oiskin Tate, was a very famous band playing at that time. You heard talk of him?

ctx.x: Yeah, well that bank book you showed me, it says, sort of proves that. Let's see, it has a date here, doesn't it? Yeah, I guess that's your wife's deposit. March 16th, 1953, Miss? Cecile Armacar. Cecile Armacar. I see. That's all. That proves that, don't it? That proves you got a good memory, man. Well now, let's see. When you went to Chicago, what kind of music did they have up there?

Well they had regular jazz music then. It was a jazz world and it was really a jazz music. The rest of the people copied from those bands then, you know, they picked it up from those bands. And so they had all the fellas, this is Dave, this is Oiskin Tate, was a very famous band playing at that time. You heard talk of him?
Sure. Did you? Teddy Weatherford? What? What I was saying. Wonderful piano player. I got a record by them, with Louis on the cornet.
